summary: @servicetitan/onboarding-ui 18.5.4 ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime binary (bun-v1.3.13) from oven-sh's GitHub release assets, unzips it to a tempdir, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled artifact (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) obfuscated with a rotated string-array scheme (`WV8StW` shuffler, `_0xNNNN` identifiers, large numeric constant table) whose contents cannot be resolved without executing it under Bun. Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` appears in the package.json `files` allowlist (which declares only `dist`, `src`, `contentful.js`, `contentful.d.ts`), yet both are shipped in the tarball and referenced by `scripts.preinstall`. The declared purpose of the package is a shared UI component library — there is no build-time need for a second language runtime to run an obfuscated sibling script. Installing this version triggers execution of opaque, alternate-runtime code on the installer's host at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
